content: 1. Glycemic status should be evaluated using A1C levels and/or continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) metrics at a minimum of twice annually. 2. For individuals who have not met their glycemic targets or experience frequent episodes of hyperglycemia or hypoglycemia, it is recommended to assess glycemic status more frequently, such as every three months. 3. In patients whose treatment regimens have recently been modified or who are not meeting their glycemic goals, glycemic status should be monitored on a quarterly basis or even more frequently, as clinically indicated.
